title: Type
description: The Type Layer contains information about type declarations, relations between types, and type instantiation and usage. It models parametrized types, type hierarchies, and aliases.

cpg:properties.name: TYPE_FULL_NAME
cpg:properties.description: Fully-qualified static type name of the represented program construct; this is an instantiated type name. If unknown, it is the empty-string default.

cpg:properties.name: ALIAS_TYPE_FULL_NAME
cpg:properties.description: Fully-qualified name of the type that the node is a type alias of.

cpg:properties.name: INHERITS_FROM_TYPE_FULL_NAME
cpg:properties.description: Static types a TYPE_DECL inherits from, matched against FULL_NAME of TYPE nodes.

cpg:properties.name: TYPE_DECL_FULL_NAME
cpg:properties.description: Static type declaration of a TYPE, matched against FULL_NAME of TYPE_DECL nodes.

cpg:nodeTypes.name: TYPE_DECL
cpg:nodeTypes.description: A type declaration such as a class, struct, or union declaration; unlike TYPE, it is not a concrete instantiation.

cpg:nodeTypes.name: TYPE_PARAMETER
cpg:nodeTypes.description: A formal type parameter of a parametrized method or type declaration.

cpg:nodeTypes.name: TYPE_ARGUMENT
cpg:nodeTypes.description: An actual type argument used to instantiate a parametrized type. The Scala documentation says CODE must be stored, but the builder does not add CODE; this declarative port preserves the builder behavior.

cpg:nodeTypes.name: MEMBER
cpg:nodeTypes.description: A type member of a class, struct, or union.

cpg:nodeTypes.name: TYPE
cpg:nodeTypes.description: A concrete type instance / instantiation of a type declaration.

cpg:edgeTypes.name: BINDS_TO
cpg:edgeTypes.description: Connects a type argument to the type parameter it instantiates.

cpg:edgeTypes.name: ALIAS_OF
cpg:edgeTypes.description: Alias relation between a type declaration and a type; loader-created from ALIAS_TYPE_FULL_NAME rather than frontend-created.

cpg:edgeTypes.name: INHERITS_FROM
cpg:edgeTypes.description: Inheritance relation between a type declaration and a type; loader-created from INHERITS_FROM_TYPE_FULL_NAME rather than frontend-created.
